allow.reason: MODULE_SPEC.md 4.2.3 split-transport opt-in: the browser agent calls the LLM in-process by default through sdkwork-llm-spi's LanguageModelPort contract; sdkwork-llm currently ships no implementation of that port, so the only callable completion path is this legacy HTTP transport. Remove this entry once sdkwork-llm exposes a LanguageModelPort implementation.
